text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That summons came
far too suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement!
The 'Summer Sprint Series' is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I ran in it last year too, didn't I?
Why go out of your way to do that?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement!
If you achieve great results in the summer sprint races,
something wonderful... might happen!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
What kind of good thing?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?
That's way too little to go on.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It is not mandatory!
You may join the regular summer training camp, or run in other races!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That is all!
Take your time to think it over!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—I know, right?
What should we do~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Hakodate Sprint Stakes in late June,
the Keeneland Cup in late August,
and the Centaur Stakes in early September.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In addition to the Hakodate Sprint Stakes that you ran previously,
I've picked out these three races while taking the intervals between them into account.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that sounds fun, but~...
As for Curren, either is fine!
I'll leave it up to you, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that sounds fun, but~...
As for Curren, either is fine!
I'll leave it up to you, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Whether to challenge the Summer Sprint Series or not...
Let me think about it a bit.
